title: Stratospheria
description: A Futuristic GUI texturepack for your futuristic themed gameplay!
body:
![STRATOSPHERIA](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9cd733cbeaed18607f2c0edf308332fed111d2af.png)

**_Expedition 1.0.0_**

![GUI Sample](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d5bb52b2af9bab4ae3ab6d10fdff75f91a109c5b.png)
================================================================================================
**_FUTURISTIC THEMED GUI_**

In need of a futuristic with neat little pixel art for your tech adventures? This pack is for you to try out!

Stratospheria Expedition 1.0.1 will soon have Mod support available:
- Apple Skin
- Traveler's Backpack
- Mekanism Tools
- Sophisticated Backpack

...and many more soon!

======================================================================================================

**_KNOWN ISSUE:_**

White and light blue text color on Main Menu bug upon re-launching Minecraft instance. It will fix itself once you join a world or server.

Haven't found a good solution to fix this atm.
